definitions.resource_transition_uncertainty_estimate: Sampling reference from transitions and polling intervals, measured in GB seconds. Interpret resource differences together with this scale and coverage. This reference describes sampling uncertainty rather than a probabilistic interval.
definitions.transition_uncertainty_reference_sum_gb_: Sum of treatment and baseline transition sampling references for the paired trial.
definitions.combined_wait_p95_seconds: P95 of each request gateway_queue_seconds plus trajectory_queue_seconds; the sum is formed before quantile calculation.
definitions.first_round_gateway_wait: Gateway actor-slot wait is included in first-round latency. Phase timing separately records TTFT, gateway wait, trajectory wait and their combined wait.
definitions.phase_timing_null: No valid completed request was observed for the corresponding phase.
definitions.resource_sampling_null: The original raw trial did not supply this resource sampling observation.
definitions.effectful_applied: Counts valid native predictions with applied_to_decision=true and finite nonzero delta_ms. The runtime observes the cost term and resulting action; a decision-changed counterfactual remains unobserved.
definitions.native_kv_observation_scope: The registered analysis and this context use scheduler_decision entries in events.jsonl. The independent Go review separately reports the union with final-state server-evidence receipts.
definitions.native_kv_delta_scale_null: No deduplicated applied prediction supplied a corresponding finite native cost value. Event references are absent when the artifact supplied no scheduler event record.
definitions.decision_changed_status: The runtime did not execute a matched counterfactual decision with the KV delta removed. Independent Go replay evidence records the action comparison separately.
definitions.performance_attribution: Paired performance differences describe the complete policy execution; the native delta scale and action diagnostics accompany causal interpretation.
definitions.analysis_receipt_reference_null: The ARM analysis receipt has reference_summary_sha256 and byte_identical_to_reference=null when no local reference full summary was transferred. Input hashes and output hashes are independently recorded.
